short: the ways marketplace's three plugin packs
is: The three Claude Code plugins the `ways` marketplace catalogs: `teams` (role briefs for the instances zaf launches, plus the design session's routines), `handoff` (the worksheet shape for asks to the Engineer) and `nodes` (charting and loading the NODE.inf.json tree).
conventions: one directory per plugin, named as the plugin, holding `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, a `README.md` and `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`
a skill runs as `/<pack>:<skill>` and an agent as `<pack>:<agent>`; a pack installs as `<pack>@ways`
packs name roles only (the Engineer, the Orchestrator), never a specific project

fs.name: handoff/
fs.role: /handoff:how-to: asks to the Engineer as a short numbered worksheet (one skill, skills/how-to/SKILL.md)

fs.name: teams/
fs.role: role briefs for the zaf instances, a doctor hook, and the design-session routines

notes: the root `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` lists each pack with `source: ./plugins/<pack>`, so a new pack needs an entry there
only `teams` has `agents/` and `hooks/`; `handoff` and `nodes` are skills only
Claude applies `handoff` unprompted whenever it asks the Engineer to act; it needs no slash command
`decide` and `research`, listed as roadmap packs in the root README, have no directory here yet
